name: 3D-VOI-LtoA
aliases: Hybrid Lossless Compression with Selective Bounding Volume
L to A coding with VOI extraction
definition: A hybrid lossless compression method for 3D medical images that combines LZW algorithm followed by Arithmetic coding, applied only to a Volume of Interest (VOI) extracted via Selective Bounding Volume (SBV).
summary: 3D-VOI-LtoA is a lossless compression method for 3D medical images that extracts the clinically significant volume of interest using a selective bounding volume to exclude zero-intensity background before hybrid LZW and arithmetic encoding.
